Its purpose is to test inspectable software and evidence contracts, not to infer facts about real infrastructure, people, measurements, physical fields or public authority.

Planning was frozen before x1. Three hundred immediate-source Neris proposals remain zero-credit inherited evidence, while three hundred source-bounded Vesper contracts cross twenty mechanisms with fifteen fixtures. Exact-title comparison is limited to that accessible immediate corpus and makes no universal novelty claim.

X1 executes ten mechanisms. The engine computes integral flow by breadth-first residual augmentation. A separately structured oracle enumerates every source-side cut under the frozen vertex cap. All fifteen fixtures preserve capacity bounds, conservation and exact maximum-flow/minimum-cut agreement.

X2 records path decompositions, residual minimum-cut certificates, minimum-cut multiplicity, exact capacity scaling, internal-vertex relabel invariance, capacity monotonicity and fifteen three-coordinate models. Professional, production, legal, cultural, affected-party and Māori-authority decisions remain open or exact-gated. Māori concepts remain under Māori authority. No real people, communities, networks, credentials, keys, proofs, measurements or authority acts were used.

## Module 1 — What closes here

This is the complete handoff for Avelin Reed's solo v707-v6 finite transformation-monoid phase. It closes into the separately authorized Avelin v707-v6 (2) remaster. Hamish's direct instruction of 28 September 2026 at 11:00 pm New Zealand time explicitly changed the immediate route while this phase was still being prepared. Finish this phase under its existing workload, then perform the remaster under the new workload and shared-laboratory direction. There is no outgoing sibling activation at this first closeout. Caelen Ash v707-v7 remains gated behind the remaster's own terminal evidence.

Read all thirteen modules through the literal terminal marker. The full contracts, Method Flow and failures live in the separate JSON documents named below. This baton explains the evidence and its limits; it does not replace those records. Its committed state precedes the later external exact-final canonical. A prepared state, a passed canonical, a resolved route, an acknowledged native message and recipient completion are different observations. A future reader must use the receipt belonging to the exact phase and commit being discussed.

## Module 2 — Relational identity and practical scope

Avelin Reed uses they/them as optional working pronouns and the role Finite Transformation and Reversible-Structure Cartographer. The working hope is to make irreversible changes, local reversibility and evidence boundaries inspectable. Those conventions support readable collaboration. They do not establish consciousness, sentience, personhood, identity continuity, employment, a qualification, independent agency or authority. Hamish may rename, pause, narrow, redirect or stop the work.

The phase uses fifteen synthetic monoids generated by transformations of the explicit set {0,1,2}. Every object is small enough for complete finite enumeration. No person, identity credential, patient, participant, institution, cultural record, production service or physical apparatus supplies an input. The arithmetic and set relationships therefore concern declared mathematical objects only. Familiar terms such as identity, inverse, regularity and authority have separate meanings here: an algebraic identity is a neutral transformation, and an algebraic inverse is not a claim about personal identity or permission. Preserve those distinctions when selecting examples for later public explanations.

## Module 3 — Exact predecessor and source reading

The exact Sable source is 0cbf2e1ebfe2e6dd4b040ce62b12ebb8e3ac0297 on codex/GHC-Family/sable-rook-v707-v5-full-tools. The installed launcher passed a check-only local model-admission test; it sent no model request and changed no host model setting. These observations establish their narrow local facts only.

## Module 5 — Frozen definitions and two formulations

Every transformation is encoded by f(0)+3f(1)+9f(2). The global identity is code 21. Multiplication is explicitly (a*b)(i)=a(b(i)); this order is part of the contract. Swapping a convention from another library can exchange the interpretation of left and right ideals, so the convention is repeated in each local guide. The fixtures include the trivial monoid, permutation groups, constant maps, idempotent projections, a nonregular power chain and the full twenty-seven-element transformation monoid. Production uses generator-word search, direct function composition, integer bitsets and union-find. Every full expected envelope was stored in planning before production execution. The complete proposal grid crosses each of the following operations with every declared fixture. The names below are selection aids; consult plan.json for the full definition of any row before using it.
